g.text: UC-P07 - Check Out a Private EV
Preconditions: Student is signed in and has a parking-session reference.
'skinparam ParticipantPadding' is ignored: use a style instead
[invalid or unverifiable context, or already checked out]
Command acknowledgement does not confirm charging stopped.
Wait for confirmed stopped state or failure/timeout
[access invalid, stop failed or final state unconfirmed]
[stop required and declined, denied, failed or still unconfirmed]
[owned Active parking and current linked states verified]
[latest state unavailable, inaccessible or charging Active again]
[owned Active parking verified with no Active charging]
[visit already closed, latest state unavailable, inaccessible or charging Active again]
[Final state check and complete checkout together]
[each unused request shown in the confirmed summary]
Close visit and complete reservation; cancel unused requests.
Release occupied space and all remaining holds once.
[charging became Active or cancellation consequences changed]
[current state unverifiable or record no longer accessible]
Keep occupancy until checkout, even after reserved departure.
